notes: Item Tracker alpha preview, third build. Unsigned, opt-in, and may change incompatibly between previews. Works with OCRX engine v2.1.1 or later. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 include. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.9.0.
changes: Added: A "Window theme" setting gives the Item Tracker window light or dark colours, or follows the Windows app mode (the default). A change applies to the open window at once.
